title: _recomputeSchedule reads balanceOf(this) directly, allowing donation griefing to extend runway and amplify DEDUP-001
asset_impact: Runway / schedule predictability impacted. No direct fund loss; donors voluntarily subsidise the pool.
attack_path:
1. Owner intends to run setTargetAPY to adjust rate.
2. Attacker front-runs with a 1-wei phUSD transfer to the staker.
3. Subsequent _recomputeSchedule reads the donor-inflated balance into V, extending windowEnd against the over-committed budget.
4. Interacts with DEDUP-001: budget reset wipes prior-emission correction.
likelihood: low - griefing only; no profit motive on its own.
assumptions: Attacker is willing to burn gas for a minor schedule perturbation; interacts meaningfully with DEDUP-001.
justification: State-handling / spec deviation (internal accounting should not trust raw balance reads). No direct asset loss. C4 Low.
